personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Premium Minimal) paired with structural radii from 4 Tactile (Cash App / Duolingo warmth)
personality_one_liner: A highly polished, trustworthy, and premium security tool that feels like a native OS feature with tactile, approachable elements.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards never flush to screen edges. Safe-area accounted for at roots.

do's: Use blur on the bottom tab bar.
Use glass headers when content scrolls beneath.
Apply to sticky floating elements like 'Paste & Scan' CTAs.
dont's: Never blur body text cards or standard inputs.
Do not use heavily saturated glassmorphism.

screens.name: Splash
screens.layout: Centered SCAM.TJ red shield logo on solid background (`surface`). No text. Fade-out transition to Onboarding/Home.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Educate the user on features without requiring login.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background (subtle gradient). Content restricted to bottom 40% using a gradient scrim to ensure text readability. Title at 2xl, subtitle at base. Sticky 'Next' / 'Get Started' button at the bottom safe area.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard showing live status and providing quick entry points.
screens.layout: 1. Header: Apple Wallet style bold title 'Overview'. 2. Hero Card (`surfaceSecondary`, `lg` radius): Large icon representing safety status, 'Protected' or similar text, and total scans metric. 3. Quick Actions: 2x2 grid of cards (`md` radius, `surfaceSecondary`) for Scan Link, Scan Message, Check Phone, AI Helper. 4. Recent Scans: List format below the grid with a 'See All' header.

states.loading: Skeleton cards for Hero and Quick Actions.
states.empty: Illustration + 'No recent scans' in the Recent Scans list area.
states.error: Banner at top: 'Failed to load stats' with retry button.

screens.name: Scan
screens.purpose: Input area to scan links, messages, or numbers.
screens.layout: 1. Segmented control (pill-style) at the top to toggle Link/Message/Phone. 2. Large text area (`surfaceSecondary`, `md` radius) filling mid-screen. 3. Sticky action block: A row with a 'Paste' button and a prominent 'Scan' primary CTA pinned to the keyboard/bottom safe area.

states.loading: Spinner covering the input area or primary button.
states.error: Red inline text below the input field if input format is invalid.

screens.name: Result
screens.purpose: Show the safety outcome of a scan.
screens.layout: 1. Hero area: Centered large icon inside a tinted circle reflecting the risk level (e.g., Red for Dangerous), bold risk text (`2xl`). 2. Details Card: List of risk indicators and offline heuristic results. 3. Action Buttons: 'Save to History', 'Ask AI about this' (pill buttons).

states.error: Failed to parse result. Show 'Unknown Error' and 'Try Again' button.

screens.name: AI Helper
screens.layout: 1. Chat log: User bubbles on right (`brandTertiary` background, `onSurface` text), AI bubbles on left (`surfaceSecondary` background). 2. Suggestion Chips: Horizontal scrollable pills above the input field for quick prompts (e.g., 'Is this safe?'). 3. Input area: Multiline input with a 'Send' icon button. Glassmorphism background for the input area.

states.loading: Typing indicator (3 dots) bubble for AI.
states.empty: Welcome message bubble from AI + 2x2 grid of Suggestion Chips.
states.error: 'Failed to connect to AI' bubble with a retry action.

screens.name: History
screens.layout: Standard list view. Each row has a leading icon (Link/Msg/Phone), a title (the scanned content truncated), a trailing risk badge (Safe/Suspicious/Dangerous), and a date. Swipe-to-delete action on rows.

screens.name: Settings
screens.layout: Grouped list style (iOS style Settings). Sections for Appearance (System/Light/Dark), Language (TG/RU/EN), Data (Clear History), and About.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design Identity: Blend iOS-Native Clean (Premium minimal, generous spacing, high contrast, clean typography) with Tactile Playful (larger rounded corners, soft padded cards).
Typography: Use `Manrope` for all text. It supports Cyrillic natively and beautifully, matching the Tajik/Russian language requirements without looking generic.

Colors: Implement the Light and Dark palettes exactly as specified. Notice that `brandPrimary` is near-black/white for standard buttons to maintain a premium Apple Wallet feel. Reserve `brand` (#DE3B40) for danger, errors, and specific brand accents like the logo.
Risk Tokens: Use the defined `riskSafe`, `riskSuspicious`, `riskDangerous`, and `riskUnknown` for the scan results. Ensure text on top of these colors uses the defined `onRisk...` tokens.
Localization: Tajik text is notoriously long. Ensure all buttons, headers, and list rows use `flex-wrap` or `numberOfLines` correctly. Never hardcode fixed heights for text containers.
Scan Screen: Ensure the 'Scan' button is always reachable and pinned to the bottom (using `KeyboardAvoidingView` or safe area), even with long text inputs.
AI Chat: Suggestion chips should populate the text input when pressed to allow user review, except for explicit quick-actions like 'Explain why this is dangerous'.
Offline/No Auth: This app has no login. Onboarding flows directly to Home. Keep the UX frictionless.

Images: For empty states or decorative icons, default to tinted Lucide/Ionicons in a `brandTertiary` circle. Do not use generic AI-generated photos. For Onboarding, you can use subtle abstract gradients or simple vector elements.
